package fixture

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// This file is data for TestRecordTableWriteScannerSelfTest (a .txt file: it is
// neither compiled nor scanned by the rule itself). Every line that must be
// flagged ends with the marker "want"; no other line may be flagged.

const tbl = "records"
const verb = "DELETE FROM " // want (a builder piece ending in a write verb)
const part1 = "UPDATE "
const part2 = part1 + "record_batches SET count = 1" // want

var (
	plain       = "INSERT INTO records (id) VALUES (1)" // want
	lower       = "insert or replace into parsers (name) VALUES ('x')" // want
	ignore      = "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO record_times (record_id) VALUES (1)" // want
	meta        = "UPDATE records_meta SET value = '9'" // want
	orRollback  = "UPDATE OR ROLLBACK records SET type = 'x'" // want
	delRuns     = "DELETE FROM record_runs" // want
	multi       = "delete\nfrom record_run_artifacts" // want
	drop        = "DROP TABLE record_superseded" // want
	dropTrigger = "drop trigger immut_records_upd" // want
	alter       = "ALTER TABLE records ADD COLUMN x" // want
	replace     = "REPLACE INTO records (id) VALUES (1)" // want
	quoted      = "INSERT INTO \"records\" (id) VALUES (1)" // want
	schema      = "INSERT INTO main.records (id) VALUES (1)" // want
	art         = "UPDATE artifacts SET path = 'x'" // want
	raw         = `DELETE FROM record_times` // want

	// evasion: concatenation of literals
	concat = "INSERT INTO " + "records (id) VALUES (1)" // want
	// evasion: named constants (a constant that already holds the whole statement is flagged where it is declared)
	viaConst  = "UPDATE " + tbl + " SET type = 'x'" // want
	viaConst2 = verb + tbl // want
	paren     = ("DELETE FROM " + ("record" + "_runs")) // want
	// evasion: a table name held in a variable
	viaVar = func(table string) string { return "DELETE FROM " + table } // want
	// evasion: Sprintf, Fprintf-style and Builder construction
	sprintf  = fmt.Sprintf("DELETE FROM %s", "record_runs") // want
	sprintfQ = fmt.Sprintf("UPDATE %q SET x = 1", "records") // want
	sprintfV = fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %v (id) VALUES (1)", tbl) // want
	nested   = strings.ToUpper("x" + fmt.Sprintf("DELETE FROM %s", "t")) // want
	builder  = func(b *strings.Builder, table string) { b.WriteString("DELETE FROM "); b.WriteString(table) } // want
)

// harmless: none of these may be flagged.
var (
	english1 = "failed to update records"
	english2 = "could not delete the records of this case"
	english3 = "cannot insert the new records into the list"
	sel1     = "SELECT * FROM records"
	sel2     = "SELECT count(*) FROM record_runs"
	sel3     = fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s", "records")
	sel4     = "SELECT 'insert into' || name FROM records"
	other1   = "UPDATE other_table SET x = 1"
	other2   = "INSERT INTO my_records VALUES (1)"
	other3   = "INSERT INTO parsers_backup VALUES (1)"
	other4   = "DELETE FROM records_archive"
	other5   = "UPDATE records_meta_x SET a = 1"
	pragma   = "PRAGMA table_info(records)"
	harmCat  = "SELECT * FROM " + tbl + " WHERE id = 1"
	harmFmt  = fmt.Sprintf("failed to update %s: %v", "records", 1)
)

// evasions of the first scanner (review of Task 6): quoting, aliases, INDEXED BY, comments.
var (
	evDQuote   = "UPDATE \"records\" SET summary = 'x'" // want
	evBacktick = "UPDATE `records` SET summary = 'x'" // want
	evBracket  = "UPDATE [records] SET summary = 'x'" // want
	evAlias    = "UPDATE records AS r SET summary = 'x'" // want
	evAlias2   = "UPDATE records r SET summary = 'x'" // want
	evIndexed  = "UPDATE records INDEXED BY records_ts SET summary = 'x'" // want
	evComment  = "DELETE FROM /**/ records" // want
	evLineCmt  = "DELETE -- go on\n FROM records" // want
	evMainQ    = "UPDATE main.\"record_batches\" SET count = 1" // want
	evDelQ     = "DELETE FROM [record_times]" // want
	evInsBr    = "INSERT INTO `parsers` (name) VALUES ('x')" // want
	evSpaces   = "UPDATE\t\n records\n\tSET x = 1" // want
	evOrQuoted = "UPDATE OR FAIL \"records\" SET x = 1" // want
	evSprintfQ = fmt.Sprintf("UPDATE \"%s\" SET x = 1", "records") // want
	evSprintfB = fmt.Sprintf("UPDATE [%[1]s] SET x = 1", "records") // want
)

// harmless next to the evasions: none of these may be flagged.
var (
	harmSetCol   = "UPDATE other_table SET records = 1"
	harmComment  = "SELECT 1 -- UPDATE records SET x = 1"
	harmBlockCmt = "SELECT 1 /* DELETE FROM records */"
	harmAlias    = "UPDATE devices AS d SET records = 1"
	harmEnglish4 = "failed to update \"records\": the table is locked"
	harmEnglish5 = "could not update the records, set aside"
)


// the full-text index (plan 5B): the FTS5 tables, their vocab tables and their shadow tables, each
// named literally, and FTS5 special commands (a write to the table they name).
var (
	ftsInsert    = "INSERT INTO records_fts (rowid, summary, body) VALUES (1, 'a', 'b')" // want
	ftsInsertSub = "INSERT INTO records_fts_sub (rowid, summary, body) VALUES (1, 'a', 'b')" // want
	ftsRebuild   = "INSERT INTO records_fts(records_fts) VALUES('rebuild')" // want
	ftsOptimize  = "INSERT INTO records_fts_sub(records_fts_sub) VALUES('optimize')" // want
	ftsDelete    = "INSERT INTO records_fts(records_fts, rank) VALUES('delete', 1)" // want
	ftsDeleteAll = "INSERT INTO records_fts_sub(records_fts_sub) VALUES('delete-all')" // want
	ftsIntegrity = "INSERT INTO records_fts(records_fts, rank) VALUES('integrity-check', 1)" // want
	ftsConcat    = "INSERT INTO " + "records_fts_sub" + "(records_fts_sub) VALUES('rebuild')" // want
	ftsConstCat  = "DELETE FROM " + ftsName // want
	ftsDelRows   = "DELETE FROM records_fts WHERE rowid = 1" // want
	ftsUpdate    = "UPDATE records_fts_sub SET summary = 'x'" // want
	ftsCreate    = "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE records_fts USING fts5(summary, body)" // want
	ftsCreateIf  = "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records_fts_sub USING fts5(summary)" // want
	ftsCreateV   = "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE records_fts_v USING fts5vocab(records_fts, 'instance')" // want
	ftsDrop      = "DROP TABLE records_fts_sub_v" // want
	ftsAlter     = "ALTER TABLE records_fts RENAME TO elsewhere" // want
	ftsQuoted    = "DELETE FROM \"records_fts_sub\"" // want
	ftsSprintf   = fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(%s) VALUES('rebuild')", "records_fts", "records_fts") // want

	// every shadow table, by name
	shData    = "DELETE FROM records_fts_data" // want
	shIdx     = "DELETE FROM records_fts_idx" // want
	shDocsize = "UPDATE records_fts_docsize SET sz = x'00'" // want
	shConfig  = "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO records_fts_config (k, v) VALUES ('version', 4)" // want
	shSubData = "UPDATE records_fts_sub_data SET block = x'00' WHERE id = 10" // want
	shSubIdx  = "DELETE FROM records_fts_sub_idx" // want
	shSubDoc  = "DELETE FROM records_fts_sub_docsize WHERE id = 2" // want
	shSubCfg  = "UPDATE records_fts_sub_config SET v = 1" // want
)

const ftsName = "records_fts_data"

// harmless: reads of the full-text index and look-alike names are not writes.
var (
	ftsMatch    = "SELECT rowid FROM records_fts WHERE records_fts MATCH ?"
	ftsRank     = "SELECT rowid, bm25(records_fts_sub, 2.0, 1.0) FROM records_fts_sub WHERE records_fts_sub MATCH ? ORDER BY 2"
	ftsVocab    = "SELECT term, doc, col, offset FROM records_fts_v ORDER BY term"
	ftsVocabSub = "SELECT term FROM records_fts_sub_v"
	ftsDocsize  = "SELECT id, sz FROM records_fts_docsize ORDER BY id"
	ftsConfig   = "SELECT k, v FROM records_fts_sub_config"
	ftsData     = "SELECT block FROM records_fts_data WHERE id = 1"
	ftsIn       = "SELECT * FROM records r WHERE r.id IN (SELECT rowid FROM records_fts WHERE records_fts MATCH ?)"
	ftsLike     = "INSERT INTO records_fts_backup VALUES (1)"
	ftsLike2    = "DELETE FROM records_fts_archive"
	ftsLike3    = "UPDATE records_fts_other SET a = 1"
)
